raw_segments.text: She had put on, without Mariette's help, the cast-aside black velvet frock.
It was too short and tight, and her slender legs looked long and thin, showing themselves
As she had not found a piece of black ribbon, her short, thick, black hair tumbled loosely
about her face and contrasted strongly with its pallor.
She held Emily tightly in one arm, and Emily was swathed in a piece of black material.
